about: S106 C3: the state verbs a check can put the game in, one registry. Placeholders are <name> (never {}: regex quantifiers). apply.script lines go into the recipe's route in order; apply.flags are added to the launch; apply.data is the -Data mirror; apply.make is run offline before the run when the mirror is missing. needs uses C1's `q save check` grammar (holder:title=T:char=C, option:caption=N, option:blood=N, dlc:mask=0xNN (equals), caw:count>=1, threads:char=C) plus build:dev. needs_lane names the lane a verb waits on. proof rows: re, min, max (optional), after (optional: a proof row whose re contains this text must match earlier), sample (a line our NEW log code prints, written from the code, for the offline self-test). fail: any match = the verb did not apply. seen.line is the exact text from the seen run (row = which proof row it matches; default 0), so tools/check/verbs.py --selftest proves every regex offline even after out/ is cleared. defaults/ranges/derive feed verbs.py expand(). Run numbers are out/build/<exe>/logs/wwe2k14_NNN.log of S105.
